description.en:
Replaces FS25's simple animal clusters with individually tracked animals - each with unique genetics, breeding, diseases, and production traits. Realistic Livestock Enhanced is a GPL-3 fork of Arrow-kb's original Realistic Livestock mod.
Every animal is tracked separately with its own identity, genetic makeup, health status, and production output. Genetics are inherited through breeding, diseases can spread and require treatment, and production is driven by each animal's individual traits. Everything is managed from the RL Menu - a dedicated tabbed interface for browsing, trading, moving, filtering, and automating your herds.
This project continues the original mod's foundations with a focus on realistic livestock systems, compatibility, fixes, and new enhancements.
Notes: - Based on Arrow-kb's Realistic Livestock mod (v1.2.0.5), released under GPL-3 license - Changes to the disease system are inspired by Renfordt's Enhanced Livestock (released under GPL-3 license), with some parts converted directly from it - Savegame data from Arrow-kb's original version is automatically migrated on first load - Font Library mod is no longer required - Do not enable alongside FS25_RealisticLivestockRM, FS25_EnhancedLivestock, FS25_MoreVisualAnimals, or FS25_EnhancedAnimalSystem - Works on virtually any map; maps that add their own custom animals or breeds have built-in support (see docs)
Project, documentation and issue tracker: https://github.com/ritorrehuelamo/FS25_RealisticLivestockEnhanced
Changelog: 1.4.1.0-dev.3: - Added the Filter button and saved-filter cycling to the trailer Transfer tab, so you can filter, then load or unload only the animals you want. - Added a coloured icon to each row of the Diseases dialog, so you can see at a glance what each disease needs. - Changed the CSV export to list only player farms' animals, with rounded numbers and more columns. - Changed the Message Log icons and added colour-blind support. - Changed which Message Log entries get an icon: red for problems you can still fix, orange for deaths and other setbacks, green for births and cures. - Changed the Diseases dialog to list the disease that most needs you first, so an untreated illness is no longer buried below the vaccines. - Changed the Diseases dialog to ask before starting, resuming or stopping a treatment. - Fixed the pen selector not getting keyboard focus when a tab opens on an empty pen. - Fixed the daily deaths summary showing the English word "from" in every language. - Fixed food, water and straw rates under 1 litre a day showing as "0L / day". - Fixed pasture pens leaving meadow grass out of the food total and feed forecast.
1.4.1.0-dev.2: - Added footrot for cattle, sheep and goats, with treatment and a vaccine. - Fixed the Diseases dialog to show the vaccine's protection and dose price, not the treatment fee, on rows you vaccinate from. - Fixed the Diseases dialog cutting off long disease names and misaligning its column headers. - Shortened the Russian insemination label so it fits the herdsman operation selector. - Explained footrot in the disease guide, the overview, the FAQ and the cattle and sheep factsheets.
1.4.1.0-dev.1: - Added vaccination: from the Diseases dialog, one dose at a time, vaccinate cattle against BRD, pigs against PED, sheep and goats against pulpy kidney, and cows and female goats against mastitis. - Added protection from the mother at birth: piglets, lambs and goat kids born in your pens to a sow, ewe or female goat that is immune to PED or pulpy kidney - vaccinated or recovered - start life protected for one month (piglets) or two months (lambs and kids). - Changed immunity and vaccination times to show in months, and stopped the info box beside an animal showing how long a past illness lasted. - Fixed multi-second freezes when moving animals with some mod combinations: the in-game Animals page no longer rebuilds its animal list while it is closed. - Fixed an animal at the dealer or in the artificial insemination catalogue occasionally missing a day of ageing and disease progress when the animal listed before it died that day. - Completed the Russian translation (contributed by frezer89). - Explained vaccination and protection from the mother in the disease and breeding guides, the FAQ and the pig and sheep factsheets.
1.4.0.0: Heads up before you update: - Every disease infection, immunity, part-way treatment and CVM carrier in your save is cleared on first load - the new disease records cannot read the old ones. Your herd starts out disease-free and CVM-free. - The Diseases setting becomes a difficulty level: an existing save lands on Normal, or Off if diseases were off. The Disease Chance setting is gone. - A sick animal that shows symptoms can no longer be sold or taken to a butcher, by you or by the herdsman. A herdsman sell rule for animals with any disease now sells none - switch it off or change its filter. - Foot and mouth treatment is now a one-month course like every other disease, instead of three months.
Added: - Added avian flu (HPAI) for chickens, BRD for cattle and pulpy kidney for sheep and goats - HPAI cannot be treated, so cull a bird that shows it straight away to stop it spreading through the flock. - Added colic, the first horse disease: a horse can fall ill with it on its own (it never spreads), grows more slowly if it is still young, and can die of it; a $500 treatment course cures it about half the time. - Added a hidden phase on Hard and Very hard: a newly infected animal of most diseases shows nothing until its symptoms appear, and on every level the "Contracted" message now arrives on the day symptoms show; an animal still in the hidden phase already spreads its disease. - Added illness effects on growth and breeding - most illnesses slow weight gain while an animal shows symptoms, and mastitis and foot and mouth also lower its chance of conceiving. - Added a Cull button to the Diseases dialog for an animal showing symptoms: it removes the animal from your herd for good and pays 33% of its current sale price, or nothing for a chicken. - Added Choose Diseases to the RL Menu settings: switch individual diseases off so no new cases of them start; animals that already have one keep it until it runs its course. - Added a message when a treatment course ends without curing the animal. - Added a credit to Renfordt's Enhanced Livestock: changes to the disease system are inspired by it, with some parts converted directly from it.
Changed: - Rebuilt the disease system to run on the daily tick instead of once a month - catching, spreading, treatment and recovery all move day by day, and each disease's chance of striking is a monthly rate by age, so longer months no longer raise it. - Turned the Diseases setting into a difficulty choice - Off, Easy, Normal, Hard or Very hard: on Easy and Normal, the default, diseases are rare or strike now and then and show symptoms at once, while on Hard and Very hard they strike more often, spread faster and most take a while to show. - Changed natural recovery so an untreated animal that survives stays sick for at least its illness's minimum length and then recovers on a daily chance - some animals now stay sick longer than others. - Changed every treatable disease to a one-month treatment course, charged day by day while it runs - foot and mouth drops from three months to one. - Changed illness effects on production - less milk, goat milk, eggs, wool and manure, and PED raises liquid manure - to apply in full while an animal shows symptoms and about half as strongly while it is still in the hidden phase. - Changed the lower sale price for a sick animal to apply only while it shows symptoms - a recovered animal or a CVM carrier now sells at full price. - Stopped sick animals being sold or taken to a butcher while they show symptoms - by you or by the herdsman. A herdsman sell rule for animals with any disease now sells none, and in mark mode marks none; a herdsman move to a butcher leaves sick animals in the pen and tells you how many it skipped. - Renamed Avian Flu to Avian Flu (LPAI) in every language, to tell it apart from the new HPAI.
Removed: - Removed the Disease Chance setting - the difficulty level replaces it.
Fixed: - Fixed saving while a horse is out of its pen removing vehicles from the save - one per horse out, taken from the start of the vehicle list and sometimes the horse itself. - Fixed January and February messages appearing below the previous year's messages in the Messages tab; pregnancy due dates, birthdays and the feed forecast now use the right year in those months too. - Fixed one bad entry in the disease definition file silently dropping every disease defined after it - an authoring mistake now warns and skips just the offending entry.
Documentation: - Rewrote the disease guide to cover all nine diseases, the hidden phase and the difficulty levels. - Corrected the settings reference: disease messages are not collected into daily summaries, though a death from disease still counts in the day's deaths summary.
1.3.2.1: - Fixed newborn rabbits on the Witcombe map never gaining health, so many of them died at their first day change - rabbits of every age now eat and drink the amounts the Witcombe support sets. - Corrected the disease guide's spread ratings - Foot & Mouth is the one disease that sustains an outbreak on its own, while PED and avian flu outbreaks usually burn out. - Documented in the pack-creation guide which curves accept decimal values - food, water and straw do, every other curve reads whole numbers only. - Enabled animal packs to set decimal food, water and straw rates, such as 0.2 - they were previously cut down to whole numbers.
description.it:
Sostituisce i semplici cluster di animali di FS25 con animali individualmente tracciati, ciascuno con genetica unica, allevamento, malattie e tratti produttivi. Realistic Livestock Enhanced è un fork GPL-3 del mod Realistic Livestock originale di Arrow-kb.
Ogni animale viene monitorato separatamente con la propria identità, composizione genetica, stato di salute e produzione. La genetica si trasmette tramite riproduzione, le malattie possono diffondersi richiedendo trattamenti, e la produzione dipende dai tratti individuali di ciascun animale. Tutto si gestisce dal Menu RL - un'interfaccia a schede dedicata per consultare, commerciare, spostare, filtrare e automatizzare le tue mandrie.
Il progetto continua le basi del mod originale con l'obiettivo di offrire sistemi zootecnici realistici, compatibilità, correzioni e nuovi miglioramenti.
Note: - Basato sul mod Realistic Livestock di Arrow-kb (v1.2.0.5), rilasciato sotto licenza GPL-3 - Le modifiche al sistema delle malattie sono ispirate a Enhanced Livestock di Renfordt (rilasciato sotto licenza GPL-3), con alcune parti convertite direttamente da esso - I dati di salvataggio della versione originale di Arrow-kb vengono migrati automaticamente al primo caricamento - Il mod Font Library non è più richiesto - Non abilitare insieme a FS25_RealisticLivestockRM, FS25_EnhancedLivestock, FS25_MoreVisualAnimals o FS25_EnhancedAnimalSystem
Progetto, documentazione e segnalazione problemi: https://github.com/ritorrehuelamo/FS25_RealisticLivestockEnhanced
